subject: th-cont
title: (R)TH.CONT.------T.C.IMP.------COS.AGN.
description: Diagram in BK(NM)-37 (Black Notated Music, Level One), a *triple-titled* schematic — Braxton uses two `------` separators to chain three terms in the title, signaling a three-way crossing rather than a binary one. (R)TH-CONT (the reality of thrust continuance) ── T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) ── COS-AGN (cosmic assignment): the question is what these three concepts produce when held in mutual three-way tension. On the page Braxton argues that 'the progressional continuum of creative music from the black aesthetic has forecasted and actualized a whole new dynamic understanding of even the instruments themselves.' C-INFO (composite information) drops from the main line to the lower-left, with CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) branching from it and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) from CULT-INFO-DY. The path bends at T-C-IMP and runs on to COS-AGN, the third title term; MTA-IMP (meta-implications) and a second INFO-AF-B branch from that stretch, with AFI (affinity insight) branching from the second INFO-AF-B, BIA (bi-aitionalism) from AFI, and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) from BIA. Structural argument: the three-way title is the diagram's argument: thrust continuance, time-continuum implications, and cosmic assignment must be read mutually rather than as binary crossings. The diagrammatic claim is that the reality of black-notated-music's thrust continuance can only be understood when both its time-continuum implications AND its cosmic assignment are honored simultaneously — a three-axis crossing rather than a single-axis tension.
